We also work in our own communities and with business leaders to encourage a culture of responsible gun ownership. young_democrats.title: About the Young Democrats of North Carolina
young_democrats.meta_description: Learn about the Young Democrats of North Carolina, our mission, leadership, and how we empower young people to organize, lead, and elect Democrats across the state.
young_democrats.sample_text: The Young Democrats of North Carolina (YDNC) serve as the official youth arm of the North Carolina Democratic Party (NCDP). The vision of the Young Democrats of North Carolina is to make North Carolina a better place by promoting its issues, its young people, and the spirit of the Democratic Party. The YDNC President and YDNC's two Young Democrats of America (YDA) National Committee Representatives serve on the State Executive Council of the NCDP, its highest governing body.
